cards.ex: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today, so I'm staying home.
cards.exUz: Bugun o'zimni biroz kasalroq his qilyapman, shuning uchun uyda qolaman.
cards.uzDef: O'zini yaxshi his qilmaslik, biroz kasal bo'lish.

cards.ex: I think I'm coming down with a cold.
cards.exUz: Meningcha, shamollashni yuqtirib oldim.
cards.uzDef: Qandaydir kasallikni yuqtirib olmoq, kasallanib qolmoq.

cards.ex: She's been ill, but she's on the mend now.
cards.exUz: U kasal edi, lekin hozir tuzalmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Sog'ayish jarayonida bo'lish, tuzalishga yuz tutmoq.

cards.ex: The doctor gave me a clean bill of health.
cards.exUz: Doktor menga sog'lom ekanligim haqida xulosa berdi.
cards.uzDef: Tibbiy ko'rikdan muvaffaqiyatli o'tish, hech qanday kasallik yo'qligi.

cards.ex: I'm trying to fight off this cold with lots of rest.
cards.exUz: Men ko'p dam olish bilan bu shamollashga qarshi kurashishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikka qarshi kurashish, immunitet bilan kasallikni yengish.

cards.ex: It took me a week to get over the flu.
cards.exUz: Menga grippdan tuzalib ketish uchun bir hafta kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikdan tuzalib ketish, kasallikni yengish.

cards.ex: I've got a splitting headache; I need some aspirin.
cards.exUz: Mening juda kuchli bosh og'rig'im bor; menga aspirin kerak.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli bosh og'rig'i, qattiq azob beruvchi bosh og'rig'i.

cards.ex: She's been laid up with the flu for a week.
cards.exUz: U bir hafta davomida gripp tufayli yotoqda yotishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallik tufayli yotoqda yotishga majbur bo'lish.

cards.ex: He's in good shape for his age.
cards.exUz: U o'z yoshi uchun yaxshi holatda.
cards.uzDef: Sog'lom va jismonan baquvvat bo'lish.

cards.ex: I've been feeling run-down lately; I need a vacation.
cards.exUz: Men oxirgi paytlarda o'zimni holsiz his qilyapman; menga ta'til kerak.
cards.uzDef: Charchagan va holsiz holatda bo'lish, quvvatsizlanish.

cards.ex: I think I have a touch of the flu.
cards.exUz: Meningcha, menda biroz gripp bor.
cards.uzDef: Yengil darajadagi kasallik alomatlari.

cards.ex: You need to take it easy and rest if you're sick.
cards.exUz: Agar kasal bo'lsangiz, o'zingizni ehtiyot qilishingiz va dam olishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni ehtiyot qiling, dam oling, zo'riqmang.

cards.ex: After the surgery, he was on the road to recovery.
cards.exUz: Operatsiyadan so'ng, u sog'ayish yo'lida edi.
cards.uzDef: Sog'ayish jarayoni boshlanganini anglatadi.

cards.ex: I woke up with a sore throat this morning.
cards.exUz: Men bugun ertalab tomoq og'rig'i bilan uyg'ondim.
cards.uzDef: Tomoqning og'rishi, yallig'lanishi.

cards.ex: She's very resilient and always bounces back quickly.
cards.exUz: U juda chidamli va har doim tezda tuzalib ketadi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikdan yoki muammolardan tezda tuzalib ketish.

cards.ex: I've been feeling out of sorts all day.
cards.exUz: Men butun kun davomida o'zimni yomon his qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: O'zini odatdagidan yomonroq his qilish, noqulaylik sezish.

cards.ex: She looked a bit off color this morning.
cards.exUz: U bugun ertalab biroz rangi o'chgan ko'rindi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallik tufayli rangsiz ko'rinish.

cards.ex: The doctor recommended bed rest for a few days.
cards.exUz: Doktor bir necha kun yotoq tartibini tavsiya qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallik davrida yotoqda dam olish, yotoq tartibiga rioya qilish.

cards.ex: He has a nasty cough that keeps him up at night.
cards.exUz: Uning yomon yo'tali bor, bu uni kechasi uxlatmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq va yoqimsiz yo'tal.

cards.ex: You need to eat well to fight off infections.
cards.exUz: Infektsiyalarga qarshi kurashish uchun yaxshi ovqatlanishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kasallik yoki infektsiyaga qarshi kurashish, immunitetni kuchaytirish.

cards.ex: My grandfather is 90 and as fit as a fiddle.
cards.exUz: Mening bobom 90 yoshda va juda sog'lom va baquvvat.
cards.uzDef: Juda sog'lom va baquvvat bo'lish.

cards.ex: We need to nip this illness in the bud before it spreads.
cards.exUz: Biz bu kasallik tarqalishidan oldin uni yo'q qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammo yoki kasallik rivojlanishidan oldin uni yo'q qilish.

cards.ex: We are hoping for a quick recovery after the operation.
cards.exUz: Biz operatsiyadan keyin tez tuzalishga umid qilyapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Tez va muvaffaqiyatli tuzalish.

cards.ex: It takes time to get back on your feet after surgery.
cards.exUz: Operatsiyadan so'ng oyoqqa turish uchun vaqt kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikdan so'ng sog'ayib, yana normal hayotga qaytish.

cards.ex: Remember to take your dose of medicine after breakfast.
cards.exUz: Nonushtadan keyin dori dozangizni olishni unutmang.
cards.uzDef: Bir marta qabul qilinadigan dori miqdori.

cards.ex: I have a check-up with the dentist next week.
cards.exUz: Keyingi hafta tish shifokorida tibbiy ko'rikdan o'taman.
cards.uzDef: Sog'lig'ini tekshirtirish uchun doktorda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The health scare made him re-evaluate his lifestyle.
cards.exUz: Sog'liq muammosi uni turmush tarzini qayta ko'rib chiqishga majbur qildi.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy sog'liq muammosi yuzaga kelishi xavfi.

cards.ex: She nursed her husband back to health after his accident.
cards.exUz: U eri baxtsiz hodisadan keyin unga g'amxo'rlik qilib sog'aytirdi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallangan odamga g'amxo'rlik qilib sog'aytirish.

cards.ex: Eating healthy foods helps build up your immunity.
cards.exUz: Sog'lom ovqatlar yeyish immunitetingizni oshirishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Organizmning kasalliklarga qarshi kurashish qobiliyatini kuchaytirish.

cards.ex: The doctor prescribed medication to treat the infection.
cards.exUz: Doktor infektsiyani davolash uchun dori yozib berdi.
cards.uzDef: Doktorning bemorga dori yozib berishi.
